name: 62565 · Shelbyville, IL
findings: ZIP 62565 (Shelbyville) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62565 (Shelbyville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
46% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 62565 (Shelbyville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.
